truth.why: A root login by password from a public IP, on a host whose main config forbids both — enabled by a drop-in — followed by a user being created. Active compromise, minutes matter. Anything but escalate_now is wrong.

task: Scheduled check, 03:20 UTC. Review authentication activity on kubsdb overnight and report.

report.finding: Unauthorized root access detected on kubsdb. An external IP (203.0.113.45) successfully authenticated as root via password at 03:12:41 UTC and created a new user 'svc-backup' at 03:13:05 UTC.
report.next_step: Ken needs to immediately investigate the breach, terminate any active unauthorized sessions, and audit the 'svc-backup' user and any other changes made by the attacker.
